mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 70 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School. Tonight, the International Space Station will be visible for 5 minutes starting at 8:25 PM, rising in the Northwest over Middleton and traveling toward the Northeast over Madison. Expect an overnight low of 62 degrees with rain moving in overnight.
The city is encouraging residents to sign up for the digital newsletter. It is the best way to get updates on all municipal programs and city projects directly from the communications office.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow or live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company on September 18.
On September 5, officers were alerted to a strange series of events where cheese was found placed on windshields across various streets in town, which was identified as a social media prank.
The Verona Culver's is currently closed today due to a scheduled remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available right now.
